change_catalogue.reason: Remove pre-custody chmod. Correct the residual claim that no uncreated source object is mutated: reads can update atime.
Withdraw foreign-owner admission refusal; selecting a non-preserving copy route does not discharge preservation.
Withdraw effective-write-bit admission refusal; copied metadata and subsequent behavior still need the original guarantee.
Withdraw set-ID output refusal. Excluded output file modes are checked transiently, not recorded in the original files map.
Withdraw cross-device directory refusal. Any copy must preserve the accepted filesystem cases rather than assume all support COPY.
Withdraw parent-stage refusal for these scans in favor of route selection. The copy-route non-success cases remain new.
Retracting the false no-changes claim is correct; no acceptance follows.
Different credentials can remove previously accepted access and signaling behavior. An engineering run cannot establish universal equivalence.
Relocated environment and non-writable HOME alter previously available paths and writes.
NNP and seccomp refuse previously permitted modes, io_uring and openat2 behavior; retaining the command allowlist does not preserve accepted actions.
Manager filters, unit masking, no PAM and no bus restrict previously available behavior; H2/BUS are compatibility obligations, not exceptions.
Different manager, slice and delegated-controller context changes scope and unit observations.
Reduced home visibility changes accepted path access in either exposure option.
Enforced frame-writer custody is required. Blanket target write denial also rejects temporary changes that the original could accept after restoration; do not infer preservation from the boundary.
Pre-created non-replaceable roots change target root lifecycle. ROOTS must not become a new input/fixture restriction.
Different credentials remove original writes; the target-write residual is an inventory, not confinement or permission to change accepted cases.
Fixed-size/noexec/cross-filesystem images cannot replace original successful capacity or native execution controls; a genuinely compatible frame remains required.

New inodes, owners, metadata omissions, mounts and disconnected late writes are real observable behavior changes. Bytes/name equivalence and finite compatibility runs cannot discharge exact preservation.
The frame causes an inode atime update on a source that may be outside T. A read label and stat_key exclusion provide no V5-B02 exception.
Retained evidence can be a design cost within T; it must be fully budgeted and cannot silently remove required backup/restore scope.
W-owned parent/root exchange is conditionally confined, but changes P_adm parent metadata after M8. Reconcile admission timing and partition invariants without deleting checks.
Extra work is a custody cost; new timeout refusals of previously successful valid operations are not preservation.
Protecting record and tree access is a custody design choice; relocated access/export cannot silently replace any required producer or source custody.
These are operator-owned setup choices with exact prestate/rollback, not authority granted by this review and not a new approval gate.
Refusal on failed/unknown enforced custody is appropriate; rejecting an originally accepted leftover or benign prior frame participant is a new gate and cannot close preservation.
R/GATE readability differs from sicarii. Also copying needs successful byte reads whereas the original excluded-file walk only opens and stats.

The observed-size data ceiling and longer copy stability window add refusals. Stable originals may also hit new source-read, SEEK_DATA/HOLE, metadata, allocation or exchange failures; not all require continuing writers.
Additional real copy/evidence cost must enter Gate 0 and cannot lower reserve. Establishing capacity may defer work. This does not authorize D3's new accepted-output growth cap.

Global uid/manager/lease conditions exceed original terminal ownership. Even ended participants and a closed foreign-owned file yield UNKNOWN. Preserve the original release obligation without durability gates.
No success credit for an unfinal stream is sound, but an externally retained writable stream is a new success restriction. No archival/durability hold may block known-terminal release.

Final leaf and custody revalidation follows V5-B01. It is still additional to original parent-child directory joins; the claim that any failure proves a K7 premise failed depends on the missing common-state proof.

Malformed messages and unavailable custody fail closed. New deadlines, record/transport failures and forced non-success after recovery are real new outcomes for valid original cases; target-driven copy/observation volume can contribute.

Umask, core limit, scope memory/swap values, allowlist and original window rules are retained at specification level. Isolate frame-v6's required final-pass repair from the original S5 baseline and do not call extended D5 an unchanged gate.

change_catalogue_assessment: Substantial and candid, but incomplete/inaccurate in the S5/S6 baseline, mode-recording and report-read history, byte-read/SEEK/attribute failures, D3/D8 causation, growth-cap and deadline effects. C1 and retained restrictions/refusals do not preserve original accepted behavior. Real unchanged-requirement capacity deferral is permissible; new caps, domain exclusions and release gates are not acceptance exceptions.
closure_boundary: CLOSED_AT_SPEC_LEVEL denotes only an exact local sealed specification correction. All original Phase One requirements and acceptance gates remain OPEN. Previously closed scopes retain that scope; newly introduced defects are assessed separately.

W1-CUSTODY.remaining_gap: Protected-writer and fresh-inode arguments improve the design. Source-read mutation, common-state observation and unchanged accepted cases remain unresolved.

W1-DURABILITY-RELEASE.remaining_gap: Retained closed scope: known-terminal release is not gated by record/export durability. Failed intent or archival recording gives no success credit but adds no hold or approval gate.

W1-GENERATION-PROTOCOL.remaining_gap: Generation/route ordering and exact refusal machines are substantially specified. C1 requires RECORDS before delivery, and copy exchange conflicts with the admitted-partition immutability assertion.

W1-IMAGE-OBSERVATION.remaining_gap: LOOKUP and named backing-file observation are conditional. Complete per-use exact images-directory entry-set verification was downgraded to operator captures.

W1-IMAGE-TREE.remaining_gap: Root ownership, opaque lost+found and missing-mount refusal are retained. Per-use images entry-set preservation remains absent; capacity/noexec compatibility is still an original obligation.

W1-JOURNAL-CONTINUATION.remaining_gap: Record-free predecessor and continuation precedence repair the old link error only when a valid continuation exists. Full failed close plus absent/invalid continuation remains contradictory.

W1-LIFETIME-ROLLBACK.remaining_gap: No late collector and reserving-front-only release remain; W2 and rollback phases are named. Journal ambiguity, common-state classification and global rollback composition remain.

W1-PROTOCOL-FAILURE-STATES.remaining_gap: Early refusal/STOP branch legality is repaired. Broader protocol closure still needs C1's data order and coherent failed-close/terminal outcomes.

W1-RESOURCES.remaining_gap: Retained closed scope: original allowances, reserve and stage expressions are not lowered. New A_copy, retained-copy/full-restore obligations and actual safe capacity are assessed separately and remain OPEN.

W1-SETUP.remaining_gap: Phase-aware same-object states improve setup. Parent effects, cross-script expectations and every-use images pin remain unresolved.

W1-SETUP-IDENTITY.remaining_gap: Retained closed scope: no self-hash fixed point; S-I/installed review/adoption externally seal the record. Universal pre-mutation wording still needs the explicitly stated adopt bookkeeping qualification.

W1-SETUP-PROBES-ROLLBACK.remaining_gap: Staging, explicit producer-status handling, atom classes, probes and rollback order are explicit. Global parent/shared-object states, every-use image pins and new premise/probe coverage remain incomplete.

W1-SETUP-RECONCILIATION.remaining_gap: ACL phases, service/check classification and reversal co-objects are present. Parent entry-set/link effects and global cross-script projections are missing.

W1-TERMINAL-CUSTODY.remaining_gap: Recorded participants, complete classifications and W2 recovery are explicit. A common-instant scan argument is missing, and D5 expands the original release domain, including UNKNOWN for closed foreign-owned files.

W1-V5-IMAGE-PINS.remaining_gap: The required complete per-use entry-set check was removed, not implemented. Known-name lookup and setup/rollback captures do not satisfy the sealed preserving correction.

W1-V5-JOURNAL-FAILED-CLOSE.remaining_gap: Continuation now skips the record-bearing marker and failed close from the earlier record-free base. A complete failed close without a valid continuation still becomes structurally committed; J5 and consumer precedence disagree with the failure rule.

W1-V5-PRESERVATION.remaining_gap: Honest OPEN inventory is progress, not preservation. C1 and B/D rows change original successful behavior; the A_copy ceiling is a new cap. No full preserving mechanism is supplied.

W1-V5-PROTOCOL-REFUSALS.remaining_gap: Literal pre-hello EARLY_REFUSAL, early L_REFUSAL/CHILD_REFUSAL and per-state STOP paths are specified, including no-start versus unknown. This closes that narrow correction, not the broader C1-data/protocol design.

W1-V5-RECONCILIATION-STATES.remaining_gap: Same-object ACL phase states, reversal intermediates and account co-objects are progress. Parent-directory effects and cross-script projections remain absent, so ordinary states can still be classified other.

W1-V5-REVOCATION-CONFINEMENT.remaining_gap: Unsafe chmod is removed and fresh destination writes are conditionally confined. K8's foreign-source atime mutation and the scan-to-common-state premise gap prevent the all-mutation claim.

k0_assessment: A sound obstruction for the stated unprivileged userspace/DAC architecture and already-shared writable open file descriptions; no preserving mechanism was identified. Not a universal proved impossibility theorem for every Linux enforcement design. Keeping both original blockers OPEN is correct; the no-output-refusal absolutes are false.
model_truth_boundary: Actual review model selection is gpt-6.1-sol in the current review context; it is not inferred from a role label. No cryptographic model attestation is claimed. No subagents or alternate-model reviewers were used.

premises.remaining: The K7 statement includes io_uring-registered writable descriptions, but the specified probe rows test live descriptors, SCM_RIGHTS queues and mappings without an explicit registered-description case. Installed-version kernel/filesystem evidence remains required.
The permission/ACL/hardlink argument is conditional on installed kernel and all accepted source filesystems. Device equality is not an exact no-mount predicate.

Add process_vm_writev and distinguish REALCREDS/FSCREDS and allowed versus denied control access under Yama and dumpability. Generic documentation supports an external-caller prerequisite, not a host proof or unqualified statement about all accesses.
The explicit exchange primitive is conditionally suitable. Include parent entry-set/timestamp and moved-root metadata effects, and every partial exchange state, not only destination references.

No blanket compatibility assumption may exclude accepted foreign owners or mounted filesystems. Specify the group-setting/readback operation, exact attribute sequencing, successful data-read and SEEK behavior, directory atime, and failure preservation. O_NOATIME does not cover foreign-owned sources.
Exact installed filter/kernel architecture and exhaustive interface coverage require source-matched evidence; legitimate original target calls cannot be excluded by assumption.
Manager/delegation/inheritance/compatibility are hypotheses; no current host setup or successful tests were used in this review.
A finite probe cannot establish that no other interface confers initial-namespace identities/capabilities. Require exhaustive source-grounded coverage of the installed interface and implementation.

The absorption argument is conditional on all Q predicates holding at a common moment. Sequential whole-population/manager/descriptor scans and equal snapshots do not specify how they establish that common state under churn. Source evidence for S4/S5 is especially material.
PAM-less runtime-directory/delegation and manager compatibility stay open; failure requires redesign.
A successful fixed run cannot establish that every original accepted allowlisted action never needs the bus. Preserve the accepted case or keep the obligation open.
The proposed non-replaceable roots must not turn possible root lifecycle behavior into a new restriction or change deterministic fixtures.
May redesign or omit this optional branch while preserving the original task. Root code/rule/source review and existing operator authorization remain mandatory.
If it fails, no allocation-failure durability claim; this is not permission to delete the original durability requirement.

premises.probe: sacrificial measured geometry and compatible execution controls
premises.remaining: Noexec or finite image geometry must not stand in for the native execution/capacity controls or add an accepted size cap.
Search-only known-name lookup can check named files but not the exact complete entry set. Restore the sealed per-use requirement without adding a new operator gate.

required_changes.change: Keep the original success domain fixed. Replace accepted-case restrictions and observable substitutions with a preserving design; where none exists, retain V5-B01, V5-B02 and W1-V5-PRESERVATION OPEN. Remove the claims that no original output state is refused and that the copy-data ceiling is not a narrowed case.
required_changes.reason: The catalogue admits restrictions, C1 changes and D1-D8 new outcomes. K4 refuses growth beyond a parent-derived data ceiling and can fail on stable originals. A finite compatibility run cannot establish preservation of every accepted case.

required_changes.change: Provide enforced confinement for every frame-caused filesystem mutation, including file/directory read-side atime updates and proof-report reads. Prevent the foreign-source side effect with a preserving mechanism or retain V5-B02 OPEN for that route; correct K5/K8's universal no-mutation and only-copy-read statements.
required_changes.reason: A read's inode update is still caused by the frame. Foreign-owned sources can be read without O_NOATIME while their name or alias is outside T; post-read restat or non-success does not undo it.

required_changes.change: Make failed-close truth observable and consistent for every writer, reader, export and reboot interpretation, including a complete valid close whose fsync, directory fsync, post-validation or join failed and whose continuation is absent or fails before producing a valid file. Preserve failure/downgrade/raw evidence; add these declarative cases to P-CHAIN.
required_changes.reason: The structural chain commits a valid primary-plus-close pair even though the write procedure declares any failed close uncommitted. J4 fixes this only after a valid skipping continuation exists.

required_changes.change: Define global phase-aware setup and rollback vectors over all effects of each atom, including parent-directory entry sets/link counts and cross-script shared objects. Project earlier and later script expectations through the current global phase. Name all ordinary partial creates, installs, removals and reversals without classifying them as other or rerunning completed creates.
required_changes.reason: Every-atom-one-object is false for filesystem creates/removals. Captured parent identities change when later children are added, and earlier final vectors cannot remain equal during a later script that changes the same object.

required_changes.change: Restore complete per-use exact images-directory entry-set verification while preserving protected exposure and role authority, or redesign the branch. Do not replace it with setup/rollback-only operator captures or add a new operator gate.
required_changes.reason: The sealed correction explicitly requires preserving every pin check. Known-name lookup and root-only modification do not verify equality of the full entry set.

required_changes.change: Limit C's first hello checks to facts available from compiled expectations, argv and kernel observations. Perform launch-environment/template and launcher-intent descriptor-pin checks only after authenticated RECORDS delivery in C2, before any spawn request. Preserve legal early refusal and STOP branches and truthful no-start/unknown outcomes.
required_changes.reason: C1 presently needs record contents before C2 supplies them, and C cannot search the protected record tree.

required_changes.change: Supply an enforced or source-grounded argument connecting complete process/credential/manager/descriptor scans to one common quiescent state under fork, exit, credential and queued-input churn. State any missing premise explicitly as unestablished with its evidence obligation. Replace 'same st_dev means no mount boundary' with the exact required predicate.
required_changes.reason: The absorption lemma requires Q1-Q8 to hold at one moment. Sequential scans and equal repetitions alone do not establish that antecedent; S1-S6 govern manager behavior rather than atomic whole-population observation.

required_changes.change: Specify the group-setting operation and readback, source/destination attribute order and compatibility for all original accepted filesystems/owners. Complete L1's registered-description coverage and P-PTRACE's process_vm_writev and access-mode/positive controls. Preserve redesign/no-exception consequences; do not promote finite probes or a first run into universal premises.
required_changes.reason: COPY and compatibility hypotheses span a broader original domain than the fixtures establish. The named L1 and ptrace interfaces are not all represented in their probe rows.

required_changes.change: Reconcile the P_adm/P_out model with root-exchange mutations of admitted parent directories and place final admission after every actual admitted-tree mutation without deleting checks. Scope 'no ACL/default ACL/no mode changes' to the intended immutable recipe/bookkeeping objects while explicitly accounting for fresh-copy attributes. Make adopt's seal timing exception to pre-mutation wording exact.
required_changes.reason: Section 4 declares P_adm immutable after M8, while C4 acknowledges parent changes during dispatch. Sections 6.1/6.2 forbid default ACLs anywhere while K4 and the partition table reproduce them. Section 11.7's universal pre-mutation seal assertion conflicts with its explicit AD3 bookkeeping order.

required_changes.change: Account for all retained originals, partial/fresh/retired copies and required temporary full-restore space under the unchanged storage obligation. Specify which protected payload dependencies let each promised channel/export reader reconstruct and verify its evidence, and how those dependencies remain available through backup/restore. Retain authentic-context vault gates and existing operator authority.
required_changes.reason: New retained roots are explicitly not backed up and have no restore term; exports omit recipe/snapshot payloads while channel verification references them. Neither an export hash nor exact budget arithmetic establishes complete original restore/evidence coverage.

required_changes.change: Correct section 21 and its cross-references: separate the original S5 baseline from the criterion-required S6 final-pass repair; correct A4's recorded-mode claim and K8/report-read baseline; enumerate copy byte-read/SEEK/attribute failures and new deadline effects; remove D3/D8 causal absolutes; distinguish legitimate capacity deferral from new caps, release gates and accepted-case refusals.
required_changes.reason: The inventory is candid but several baseline and causal claims are false or incomplete. Listing an OPEN incompatibility is truthful; it is not proof that the requirements are met.

routes_assessment: The in-place predicate is explicit and checked at the parent and again in the correctly placed child final pass, but it depends on unestablished kernel/systemd/credential premises and a missing common-instant complete-scan argument. Device equality is not a complete no-mount predicate. Copy-route explicit destination creates/writes/exchanges are conditionally confined on PTRACE-GID, EXCH, COPY and complete credential closure; source-read atime side effects defeat K5's universal all-mutation claim. K8's foreign-source atime update counts as a frame-caused mutation under V5-B02. Exact original behavior and fresh-copy attribute/source-read compatibility are not established.
